steps.en: Install the desktop launcher with the platform script
steps.zh: 用平台脚本安装桌面 launcher

steps.en: Verifies checksums and sets up the bundled browser and Bun runtime
steps.zh: 校验校验和，部署自带的浏览器与 Bun 运行时

steps.en: Sign in to ChatGPT in the launcher's embedded browser
steps.zh: 在 launcher 内嵌浏览器里登录 ChatGPT

steps.en: Keeps the session in a private profile and runs the browser smoke test
steps.zh: 把会话存进私有 profile，跑浏览器冒烟测试

steps.en: Install the models, restart Codex, pick a ChatGPT Web row
steps.zh: 安装模型，重启 Codex，选中一条 ChatGPT Web 模型

steps.en: Serves the catalog on loopback; each turn streams through a ChatGPT Temporary Chat back into Codex
steps.zh: 在 loopback 服务模型目录；每回合经临时对话流回 Codex

value.en: Codex tasks run on your ChatGPT web allowance — Codex quota untouched
value.zh: Codex 任务跑在 ChatGPT 网页额度上——Codex 配额分毫未动

sources: https://github.com/miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web README Get started (install-launcher.sh / .ps1, sign in + smoke test, install models, restart Codex, choose a ChatGPT Web model)
https://github.com/miuuyy/codex-chatgpt-web docs/architecture.md (loopback Responses daemon, Electron partition sign-in, Temporary Chat turn streaming, bundled browser/runtime)
